MESSAGE FROM DEVELOPER:
Please try to explain whatever bugs you find - detailed feedback helps me find bugs and fix them sooner.

A challenging First-Person action climbing game about using both hands to grip on rocks and ledges while using body momentum to perform dangerous leaps from rock to rock.

Tips:
- Mobile buttons are customizable.
- Make sure to keep graphics at least level 4.
- You can teleport between checkpoints.
- Get familiar with available options in the game's settings (⚙ button).
- Press C to unlock mouse (enter third person).
- Press R to return to checkpoint.

! MOTION-SICKNESS WARNING ! Glitches or rapid movement may occur.

FOUND BUGS? Please explain exactly WHAT bugs you found in your FEEDBACK.

Climbing mechanics inspired by Peaks of Yore (game on Steam).
